title: Onecoin German Sale of Onecoins
description: We recommend selling OneCoins. You can find our recommendations at www.deutschlandteam.nl.

asr.full_text: 1. The sale of 1coins Good day! My name is Ralf Passing. I want to show you today, how you can get 1coins back to euros. This is the sale of 1coins. To make money from 1 coins you have to market in the market, but there is still no free trade for this platform. After some short moments the price on the brokerage increased by 4,35 €. then check if the value is correct and the increase in value compensates the sales that makes the total value of the stock of 1 coin measured in euros almost not reduced So if you want to sell, then go to Exchange in the backoffice you click first on exchange and in trading for example. Unfortunately, the option of buying is extremely limited Even against all the claims the option is not so much asable. of your own and for example of traders. By trading at the same day, you would only be able to sell on your daily basis on Monday and Friday. Only two Woncoins can be traded by traders or traders. This would be twice as big as buying and selling a single coin in the UK. One thing to note, is that trading non-profit, in itself, would cost less than ten dollars. you can buy one coin about a 100 US, because it costs an increase of 12 euros. ProTrader and Executives, for a maximum cost of 36 euros, is on offer. And Tycoons, who put up an investment of 5,000 euros on the coin, can sell a maximum profit of 60 euros per day at a rate order is set. Even for premium members the sales limit to 120 euros is limited to. The sales orders are set via Ask. Go to Place Order and click on the red button. So if we use a ProTrader account, you can see that the limit has already been reached with 8 1Coins. So the equivalent value of 8 1Coin is, therefore, 34,80 Euro. As a result, the maximum amount is already 36 Euros. If we were to sell 9 1 Coins, we would go beyond the limit. Since even this internal stock market... has extreme restrictions, we have decided to exit the OneCoins... and instead earn from Bitcoin mining. On our website Deutschlandteam.nl there is infos leads to our recommendations to keep a good business from Bitcoin mining. I advice you to consistently go for Onecoin. Log in daily and do the selling until you have returned to it. Thank you for your attention. I wish you a pleasant day. Please listen again.

textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether viewers were required to pay additional money, whether any recovery occurred, or what 'returned to it' means.

visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not establish whether any sale occurred, whether the internal exchange was accessible, or what outcomes users experienced.

visual.limitations: The sampled frames do not show the original announcements, membership purchase terms, or whether the listed restrictions were enforced for specific users.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents OneCoin returns as dependent on selling through an internal exchange and cites a 5,000-euro investment for up to 60 euros in daily profit. It describes repeated account activity, sell orders, transaction values, fees, and a password field, while acknowledging severe selling restrictions and directing viewers toward Bitcoin-mining earnings and recommendations at deutschlandteam.nl. The material does not establish website behavior, completed transactions, realized returns, or user losses.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central observed mechanism links participation in OneCoin, including a stated investment in the coin, to selling for euros and a claimed profit. This supports token purchase or holding returns under S05. The evidence does not establish that any sale or profit was completed.
